title: Variance
description: This datapack adds new biome dependent varaints to cows, pigs and chickens along side their vanilla couterparts. It also adds a few nametag easter eggs
body:
This datapack adds 7 biome dependent variants each for chickens, pigs and cow:
- Sandy: These spawn in deserts and both eroded and normal badlands.
- Cherry: These only spawn in cherry groves.
- Icy: These spawn in snowy plains and slopes, ice spikes, frozen peaks and groves.
- Jungle: These spawn in both sparse and normal jungles.
- Pale: These only spawn in pale gardens.
- Mushroom: These only spawn on mushroom islands. Since mooshrooms already exist only new mushroom pigs and chickens are added.
- Forest: These spawn in dark, birch, taiga and normal forests, as well as their old growth variants.

Along side these the datapack also adds 6 new nametag easter eggs:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Moo: This turns cows into the ones from moo moo meadows in mariokart.
- Mentality: This turns cows pink, like the one in herd mentality.
- Shane: This turns a chicken blue, like the ones from stardew valley.
- Void: This turns a chicken into a void chicken from stardew valley.
- Angry: This turns a pig green, like the ones from angry birds.
- Legend: This gives a pig a technoblade crown.






</details>
The required resource pack for this can be found alongside the datapack if you click on the version you wish to install.
